profile.headline: Full Stack Software Developer at Quantum Computing, Inc.
profile.summary: I was previously a Medic in the Air Force but have changed my career path to Full Stack Development.  I enjoy challenging myself with logical puzzles like Rubik's Cubes and fill out my free time playing piano or walking my dog.

positions.title: Full Stack Software Developer
positions.description:
•Contributed to the development and successful launch of the company's website, translating Figma designs into a seamless user experience
•Implemented front-end solutions using a diverse tech stack including React, Angular, Vue, JavaScript, and TypeScript, ensuring dynamic and responsive user interfaces
•Engaged in back-end development leveraging technologies such as GoLang and Python, crafting robust and scalable server-side functionalities
•Managed infrastructure tasks, particularly in Micro Services architecture, deploying and maintaining Kubernetes on AWS for optimized performance and scalability
•Oversaw database development and maintenance, proficiently utilizing MongoDB to organize and manage data efficiently

positions.title: Full Stack Engineering Student
positions.description:
Solo Project: Adventure Book
•Completed developing a full stack application which utilizes multiple SQL junction tables & user authentication for security
•The Adventure Book allows users to create their own complex stories with multiple branching endings
•Technologies include PostgreSQL, Express, React & Node.js, wrapped in Material UI

Group Project: Sponsorship Hub
•Developed a full stack application with client that allows brands such as Red Bull get the information they need on events using advanced SQL queries
•Consists of multiple authentication/authorization measures for security
•Utilizes the following technologies: PostgreSQL, Express, React and Node.js

Lectures
•Learning new technologies that are used in today's tech industry
•Public speaking practice & toastmasters are frequently performed in class to increase communication skills

positions.title: In Home Advisor Support Team Lead (Best Buy)
positions.description:
IN HOME ADVISOR SUPPORT TEAM LEAD (March 2019 - February 2020) | Richfield, MN 
•Assist in building the new In Home Advisor (IHA) Support Team from the ground up
•Manage and train a team of three to support over 650 IHAs
•Ensure IHAs receive excellent support specially tailored to their unique schedules
•Create & updates knowledge articles to assist current and new associates

LEVEL 2 RETAIL ANALYST (September 2017 - March 2019) | Richfield, MN
•Provide technical support for Best Buy retail locations in the US & Canada
•Re-image workstations, registers, and kiosks remotely
•Troubleshoot various products used in Best Buy retail stores such as hand scanners and signature pads
•Utilize a phone queue to provide timely responses to technicians on the field

positions.title: Personal Care Assistant
positions.description:
•Supervision of patients for health & safety
•Behavior redirection & intervention
•Assist disabled client in daily living & health-related tasks
•Manage nutrition for patients per dietary guidelines

positions.title: Emergency Medical Technician
positions.description:
•Bestowed the Air Force Achievement Medal for outstanding achievement and Certificate of Appreciation from President Barack Obama
•Nationally registered EMT with active BLS/CPR card 
•Held secret level security clearance
•Lead Yokota’s Family Health Clinic to become ranked 3rd in the Air Force in 2011/awarding clinic $46.2K
•Provided medical coverage for 2011 Japan earthquake; distributing over 40,000 Potassium Iodide pills to prevent radiation
•Assisted customers with product inquiries, ordering, and provided recommendations 
•Arranged an estimated 150 minor surgical procedures using sterile field w/ aseptic technique with zero percent infection rate

positions.title: Billing Specialist
positions.description:
•Communicated effectively to customers regarding billing related inquiries to ensure client satisfaction and one contact resolution
•Utilized various software tools to research and correct inaccurate invoices
•Prioritized multiple requirements to update customers’ address, bank details, and contact information
•Manually processed over 3,000 invoices monthly for high revenue customers ensuring accurate billing
•Redesigned work process that increased revenue by roughly $20,000 each month

positions.title: Assistant Manager
positions.description:
•Assisted customers with product inquiries, ordering, and provided recommendations 
•Performed cash management duties
•Exceeded monthly quota for magazine subscriptions and product reservations

positions.title: Night Manager
positions.description:
•Tasked to answer various campus related questions
•Experience in a variety of computer applications
•Verified identification and dealt with intoxicated students

honors.title: Certificate of Appreciation
honors.issuer: Issued by President George W. Bush · May 2020

honors.title: Air Force Achievement Medal
honors.issuer: Issued by Lieutenant Colonel Randy O. Claxton · Oct 2012
